name: Live online
heading: Live online Adobe and AI training
summary: Scheduled classes taught in real time by an instructor who can see your screen. Same syllabus as the classroom, recording kept for twelve months.
body_html:
A live online class is a scheduled class, not a video library. An instructor teaches it in real time, you work along on your own machine, and you can interrupt. This is the delivery mode most of our learners choose, and it is the one that makes the catalogue available outside Sri Lanka: the same syllabus, the same exercise files, the same workbook and the same certificate as the Colombo classroom. If you want to learn at your own pace instead, that is a different product, and the self-paced library is where to look.

Here is how a day actually runs. Before it starts you receive a joining link, the exercise files and a short setup list, and we run a setup check so that nobody spends the first morning fighting an Adobe sign-in. The instructor shares their screen at working resolution and demonstrates a step; you then do the same step on your own file while the instructor is still there. When you want someone to look at your work you share your screen, which is the online equivalent of the instructor walking the room, and it is the reason class sizes are kept small rather than sold as a webinar. Questions go in the chat or out loud, whichever you prefer. There are proper breaks, and each session ends with something finished rather than a slide summary.

What you need is modest but not optional. You need the software installed and licensed on your own machine before day one, because the course fee covers the training and not an Adobe licence, and if your employer's laptop blocks installations you should raise it with your IT team when you book rather than the night before. You need a connection that holds a video call for a working day, and a headset makes the difference between following the class and guessing. A second screen, or a tablet or laptop beside your main machine for the class window, is the single most useful thing you can add: on one screen alone you will spend the day switching between the instructor's demonstration and your own file.

Time zones are handled explicitly. Classes are scheduled from Colombo, which is UTC+5:30, and every date on the schedule shows its start and finish time converted to your own local time so you are never doing the arithmetic yourself. In practice the dates cluster into a few bands: South Asia and Sri Lanka, the Gulf, which is ninety minutes to two hours behind Colombo, and the UK and Europe, where a Colombo afternoon start is a comfortable morning. Where a course draws enough demand from a band, we open a cohort inside it, and the schedule is the authority on what is currently running rather than any promise on this page. Evening and weekend cohorts appear for the same reason.

Things go wrong, so this is what happens when they do. If your connection drops, rejoin with the same link; the class carries on and the instructor will recap the step you lost. If you miss a whole session, the recording is available to you for twelve months and carries captions, and every live booking includes one free repeat of the same class if you would rather sit the day again with an instructor in the room. If you fall behind during an exercise, say so in the chat, because the instructor would rather slow down than lose you. Instructor email support after the course covers questions on the exercises themselves.

Payment and paperwork work the same way as the classroom. Learners and organisations in Sri Lanka are charged in LKR, everyone else in USD, employers can be invoiced against a purchase order, and teams of about five or more are usually better served by a private online cohort built around their own files. Tell us about any access requirements when you book and we will tell you what we can do for your date. On certification, the position online is the same as it is in the classroom: the Adobe Certified Professional exams are Adobe's, delivered through Certiport at authorised test centres, the voucher is bought separately, and we prepare you for the exam rather than award it.
